name: Professional Photo Editing & Retouching
summary: One editing package for portraits, products, real estate, restoration, and composites. Professional Photoshop editing and retouching, delivered in 4 days, with 3 revisions.
covered: Object or person removal or addition

beforeAfter.caption: Color & HDR enhancement
beforeAfter.alt: Before and after of a Kuala Lumpur night skyline. The original darker photo is inset at the bottom left and labeled Before. The large retouched image, labeled After, is brighter with richer color and more HDR detail in the buildings, lights, and water.

beforeAfter.caption: Skin retouching & background swap
beforeAfter.alt: Side-by-side before and after portrait. The Before photo on the left shows the original skin and background. The After photo on the right shows smoother skin retouching and a replaced, cleaner background.

beforeAfter.caption: Object/person removal
beforeAfter.alt: Side-by-side before and after of a group photo. The Before photo on the left includes a person in the frame. The After photo on the right has that person removed and the background filled in.
